C0826.title: Linxia City Cracks Down on Impersonation of Leaders Telecom Fraud Case
C0826.summary: On July 7, 2025, a resident surnamed Huang in Linxia City reported that an unknown WeChat account impersonated their workplace leader and tricked them into making an urgent transfer to a designated account. Police quickly solved the case and arrested the suspect.

references.title: Quick Action: Linxia Police Crack a 'Boss Impersonation' Telecom Fraud Case
